core.title: Validity Is Not Visibility: A Lifecycle FSM for Agent Memory
core.abstract: Long-term memory for LLM agents must answer two questions for every stored fact: whether the fact is still true and whether it should be surfaced for a given query. We refer to these two dimensions as validity and visibility, respectively. Existing memory systems often collapse these two decisions into a single scalar score. However, current and historical queries may require opposite retrieval decisions for the same fact: a superseded fact should be hidden for a current-intent query but surfaced for a historical-intent one. This creates a structural failure mode: superseded and expired facts are collapsed onto the same validity axis. To address this problem, we propose MemFSM, a training-free retrieval-side layer that separates validity from visibility through a memory-lifecycle finite-state machine. Along the validity axis, a four-state FSM tracks whether each fact has been superseded and expired. Along the visibility axis, an intent-aware router decides whether to surface or hide a fact based on its state and the query intent. By decoupling visibility from validity, MemFSM improves performance across heterogeneous memory benchmarks and diverse LLM backbones. To evaluate memory systems under fact conflicts and diverse query intents, we further introduce ValidMem, a benchmark that annotates each fact with both supersedure and expiry labels and pairs each memory store with both current-intent and historical-intent queries.

core.title_zh: 有效性并非可见性：智能体记忆的生命周期有限状态机

article.lead: 大语言模型智能体的长期记忆不仅要判断事实是否仍然有效，还要判断它是否应出现在当前回答中。本文提出将两者分开处理，为理解历史事实的检索提供了一个视角。

sections.title: 事实不再有效，仍可能值得检索
paragraphs: 长期记忆需要面对的一个难题是：同一事实是否应该被呈现，取决于用户正在问什么。对于已被新事实取代的记录，面向当前情况的查询应当隐藏它；但如果用户询问历史情况，它又可能需要被检索出来。
摘要指出，现有记忆系统经常把有效性与可见性合并为单一标量分数，也将被取代和已过期的事实压缩到同一有效性轴上。这种处理可能难以表达当前意图和历史意图所需的相反检索决策。

sections.title: 用生命周期状态连接查询意图
paragraphs: 作者提出 MemFSM：一种无需训练的检索侧层，通过记忆生命周期有限状态机将有效性与可见性分开。在有效性维度，四状态有限状态机跟踪每条事实是否被取代以及是否过期。
在可见性维度，意图感知路由器根据事实状态和查询意图，决定呈现还是隐藏该事实。摘要同时介绍了 ValidMem 基准：它为事实标注被取代与过期两类标签，并为每个记忆库配对当前意图和历史意图查询。

sections.title: 跨记忆基准与模型骨干的表现
paragraphs: 摘要报告，将可见性与有效性解耦后，MemFSM 在不同类型的记忆基准和多种大语言模型骨干上提升了表现。这一结果对应的是摘要所概括的整体发现，具体提升幅度和各项指标并未在摘要中给出。

core.title: UniMem: Complementary Episodic-to-Parametric Memory for Boundary-Agnostic Task Streams
core.abstract: Memory is essential for LLM agents to accumulate task experience and reuse task-specific execution strategies. However, real-world deployment over boundary-agnostic and evolving task streams exposes a fundamental stability-plasticity dilemma. External retrieval-based memory can rapidly absorb new evidence, but it often fails to internalize recurring execution patterns and incurs inference-time retrieval overhead. Parametric memory enables stable and efficient execution once learned, but typically relies on explicit task boundaries and fixed parameter budgets. Inspired by the human brain, which balances plasticity and stability through complementary episodic storage and gradual consolidation, we propose UniMem, a self-routing framework for autonomous memory management. UniMem uses learnable routing tokens as memory controllers, enabling adaptive coordination between complementary memory pathways: novel or sparse tasks are retained in an episodic buffer for retrieval-augmented execution, while recurring and reliable patterns are consolidated into expandable parametric memory. By decoupling task identification from task execution with routing tokens and parametric memory blocks, UniMem expands memory on demand without task labels during deployment or uncontrolled parameter growth. Experiments on long-horizon streaming task sequences show that UniMem typically achieves strong aggregate results while maintaining routing and execution stability, with an average gain of 4.0 EM over Replay LoRA.

article.lead: 大语言模型智能体如何在持续变化、任务边界不明确的任务流中积累经验，同时兼顾新知识吸收与已有能力稳定？UniMem 尝试用互补的记忆路径回应这一问题。

sections.title: 持续任务流中的记忆两难
paragraphs: 智能体需要记住任务经验，并在后续任务中复用相应的执行策略。但当任务持续变化、边界又不明确时，记忆既要有吸收新证据的灵活性，也要保持已学能力的稳定性。
摘要指出，外部检索式记忆能够快速吸收新证据，却常常难以内化反复出现的执行模式，并带来推理时检索开销；参数化记忆在学成后可以稳定、高效地执行，但通常依赖明确的任务边界和固定参数预算。

sections.title: 用路由协调情景记忆与参数记忆
paragraphs: 受到人脑通过互补的情景存储和渐进巩固来平衡可塑性与稳定性的启发，作者提出自主记忆管理框架 UniMem。它以可学习的路由令牌作为记忆控制器，自适应地协调不同记忆路径。
对于新颖或稀疏的任务，框架将其保留在情景缓冲区，用于检索增强执行；对于反复出现且可靠的模式，则将其巩固到可扩展的参数化记忆中。路由令牌与参数记忆块将任务识别和任务执行解耦，使记忆能够按需扩展，部署时不需要任务标签，也避免参数无控制增长。

sections.title: 长程任务流上的摘要结果
paragraphs: 摘要报告，在长程流式任务序列实验中，UniMem 通常取得较强的综合结果，同时保持路由与执行稳定性。相较于 Replay LoRA，其平均提升为 4.0 EM。

因此，综合结果和平均提升应按摘要所述理解，不能据此推断框架在所有任务上的表现，或认定其已在特定实际部署环境中得到验证。

core.title: Unified-MAS: Universally Generating Domain-Specific Nodes for Empowering Automatic Multi-Agent Systems
core.abstract: Automatic Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) generation has emerged as a promising paradigm for solving complex reasoning tasks. However, existing frameworks are fundamentally bottlenecked when applied to knowledge-intensive domains (e.g., healthcare and law). They either rely on a static library of general nodes like Chain-of-Thought, which lack specialized expertise, or attempt to generate nodes on the fly. In the latter case, the orchestrator is not only bound by its internal knowledge limits but must also simultaneously generate domain-specific logic and optimize high-level topology, leading to a severe architectural coupling that degrades overall system efficacy. To bridge this gap, we propose Unified-MAS that decouples granular node implementation from topological orchestration via offline node synthesis. Unified-MAS operates in two stages: (1) Search-Based Node Generation retrieves external open-world knowledge to synthesize specialized node blueprints, overcoming the internal knowledge limits of LLMs; and (2) Reward-Based Node Optimization utilizes a perplexity-guided reward to iteratively enhance the internal logic of bottleneck nodes. Extensive experiments across four specialized domains demonstrate that integrating Unified-MAS into four Automatic-MAS baselines yields a better performance-cost trade-off, achieving up to a 14.2% gain while significantly reducing costs. Further analysis reveals its robustness across different designer LLMs and its effectiveness on conventional tasks such as mathematical reasoning.

article.lead: 自动多智能体系统如何应对医疗、法律等知识密集型任务？Unified-MAS 将专业节点的生成与系统拓扑编排分开，为理解专业知识如何进入自动多智能体系统提供了一个视角。

sections.title: 通用节点与即时生成的两难
paragraphs: 自动多智能体系统生成被视为解决复杂推理任务的一种有前景的范式，但进入知识密集型领域时，节点的专业能力成为关键问题。依赖静态通用节点库的框架，例如使用思维链节点的框架，可能缺少所需的领域专长。
另一种做法是即时生成节点，但编排器既受自身知识范围限制，又要同时生成领域逻辑和优化高层拓扑。摘要认为，这种架构耦合会降低系统整体效能。

sections.title: 离线合成专业节点，分离实现与编排
paragraphs: Unified-MAS 的核心思路是通过**离线节点合成**，将细粒度的节点实现与拓扑编排解耦。它首先采用基于搜索的节点生成，检索外部开放世界知识，合成专业化的节点蓝图，以突破大语言模型内部知识的限制。
随后，基于奖励的节点优化利用困惑度引导的奖励，迭代改进瓶颈节点的内部逻辑。摘要将这两个环节作为方法的两个阶段，但没有给出奖励的具体计算方式或节点蓝图的详细形式。

sections.title: 摘要报告的性能、成本与适用性
paragraphs: 摘要报告，在四个专业领域的实验中，将 Unified-MAS 集成到四个自动多智能体系统基线后，取得了更好的性能—成本权衡：性能提升最高达 14.2%，同时成本显著降低。摘要未说明这一最高增益对应的具体指标、任务或比较条件。
进一步分析显示，该方法在不同设计者大语言模型下具有鲁棒性，并在数学推理等常规任务上表现出有效性。摘要没有列出这些分析的具体结果，因此不宜据此判断各模型或各任务上的提升幅度。

core.title: Unified Context Evolution for LLM Agents
core.abstract: LLM-based agents can solve multi-step interactive tasks by combining reasoning with environment feedback, yet each episode starts from the same fixed context and any useful strategy discovered along the way is lost once the task ends. Existing approaches either limit learning to the current task or pool all experience into a single untyped store, without distinguishing knowledge types, tracking quality through use, or balancing what the library still lacks. We introduce Unified Context Evolution (UCE), a gradient-free framework that externalizes agent experience into an evolving library of typed Evolvable Context Units (ECUs). UCE decomposes experience into four complementary types (Memory, Strategy, Workflow, and Skill), each generated from trajectories under type-specific conditions, retrieved at decision time, scored through repeated usage outcomes, and pruned when no longer valuable. A scheduling module allocates each cycle’s generation budget toward the types where the library is weakest. Across two interactive benchmarks, UCE raises ALFWorld success from 75.4% to 96.3% and WebShop task score from 45.1% to 61.3%, and remains effective across alternative actor reasoning backbones without model retraining.

sections.title: 任务结束后，有用策略如何留下
paragraphs: 基于大语言模型的智能体可以结合推理与环境反馈，解决多步交互任务。但摘要指出，每次任务开始时使用的是相同的固定上下文，过程中发现的有用策略也会随任务结束而流失。
已有方法要么将学习限制在当前任务，要么把经验汇集到不区分类型的单一存储中。后者难以区分知识类别、依据使用情况跟踪质量，也没有兼顾知识库仍然缺少哪些内容。

core.title: TRUST-SQL: Tool-Integrated Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning for Text-to-SQL over Unknown Schemas
core.abstract: Text-to-SQL parsing has achieved remarkable progress under the Full Schema Assumption, where the complete database structure is pre-loaded into the model’s context. Yet this assumption overlooks a more fundamental capability question of whether an LLM agent can resolve a query without explicit access to the underlying tables and relations. Moreover, full-schema injection may exceed the effective context window, introduce irrelevant metadata into the reasoning process, and become less reliable as databases evolve. We therefore study the Unknown Schema setting, in which an agent must actively explore the database and commit to only the relevant subset of metadata. To address this, we propose TRUST-SQL (Truthful Reasoning with Unknown Schema via Tools). We formulate the task as a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process in which our autonomous agent follows a structured four-phase protocol to ground reasoning in verified metadata. This protocol provides a structural boundary for our novel Phase-Aware GRPO strategy, which applies token-level masked advantages to isolate exploration rewards from execution outcomes and resolve credit assignment, yielding a 9.9% relative improvement over standard GRPO. Extensive experiments across five benchmarks demonstrate that TRUST-SQL is effective at multiple scales (4B/ 8B/14B). Despite operating entirely without pre-loaded metadata, our agent matches or surpasses prior baselines on most benchmarks that rely on schema prefilling.

core.title_zh: TRUST-SQL：面向未知数据库模式的工具集成多轮强化学习

article.lead: 当数据库结构没有预先提供给模型，大语言模型智能体还能把自然语言问题转化为 SQL 查询吗？TRUST-SQL 围绕这一问题，将数据库探索与强化学习结合，为理解未知结构下的 Text-to-SQL 提供了一个切入点。

sections.title: 从完整结构预载到未知结构探索
paragraphs: Text-to-SQL 的许多进展建立在“完整结构假设”上：模型的上下文中预先装入完整数据库结构。但这并不能直接回答，智能体在不了解底层表及其关系时，能否自行解决查询问题。
摘要指出，注入完整结构可能超出有效上下文窗口，也可能让无关元数据干扰推理；随着数据库演变，这种方式的可靠性还可能下降。未知结构设定因此要求智能体主动探索数据库，只选取相关的元数据子集。

sections.title: 用分阶段探索连接可信元数据与训练
paragraphs: TRUST-SQL 将任务建模为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程，让自主智能体遵循结构化的四阶段协议，以经过验证的元数据作为推理依据。摘要没有展开各阶段的具体操作。
这一协议也为 Phase-Aware GRPO 提供结构边界。该策略使用词元级掩码优势，将探索奖励与执行结果区分开来，以解决奖励归因问题。

sections.title: 无预载元数据下的基准表现

papers.title: Validity Is Not Visibility: A Lifecycle FSM for Agent Memory
papers.abstract: Long-term memory for LLM agents must answer two questions for every stored fact: whether the fact is still true and whether it should be surfaced for a given query. We refer to these two dimensions as validity and visibility, respectively. Existing memory systems often collapse these two decisions into a single scalar score. However, current and historical queries may require opposite retrieval decisions for the same fact: a superseded fact should be hidden for a current-intent query but surfaced for a historical-intent one. This creates a structural failure mode: superseded and expired facts are collapsed onto the same validity axis. To address this problem, we propose MemFSM, a training-free retrieval-side layer that separates validity from visibility through a memory-lifecycle finite-state machine. Along the validity axis, a four-state FSM tracks whether each fact has been superseded and expired. Along the visibility axis, an intent-aware router decides whether to surface or hide a fact based on its state and the query intent. By decoupling visibility from validity, MemFSM improves performance across heterogeneous memory benchmarks and diverse LLM backbones. To evaluate memory systems under fact conflicts and diverse query intents, we further introduce ValidMem, a benchmark that annotates each fact with both supersedure and expiry labels and pairs each memory store with both current-intent and historical-intent queries.

papers.title: UniMem: Complementary Episodic-to-Parametric Memory for Boundary-Agnostic Task Streams
papers.abstract: Memory is essential for LLM agents to accumulate task experience and reuse task-specific execution strategies. However, real-world deployment over boundary-agnostic and evolving task streams exposes a fundamental stability-plasticity dilemma. External retrieval-based memory can rapidly absorb new evidence, but it often fails to internalize recurring execution patterns and incurs inference-time retrieval overhead. Parametric memory enables stable and efficient execution once learned, but typically relies on explicit task boundaries and fixed parameter budgets. Inspired by the human brain, which balances plasticity and stability through complementary episodic storage and gradual consolidation, we propose UniMem, a self-routing framework for autonomous memory management. UniMem uses learnable routing tokens as memory controllers, enabling adaptive coordination between complementary memory pathways: novel or sparse tasks are retained in an episodic buffer for retrieval-augmented execution, while recurring and reliable patterns are consolidated into expandable parametric memory. By decoupling task identification from task execution with routing tokens and parametric memory blocks, UniMem expands memory on demand without task labels during deployment or uncontrolled parameter growth. Experiments on long-horizon streaming task sequences show that UniMem typically achieves strong aggregate results while maintaining routing and execution stability, with an average gain of 4.0 EM over Replay LoRA.

papers.title: Unified-MAS: Universally Generating Domain-Specific Nodes for Empowering Automatic Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: Automatic Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) generation has emerged as a promising paradigm for solving complex reasoning tasks. However, existing frameworks are fundamentally bottlenecked when applied to knowledge-intensive domains (e.g., healthcare and law). They either rely on a static library of general nodes like Chain-of-Thought, which lack specialized expertise, or attempt to generate nodes on the fly. In the latter case, the orchestrator is not only bound by its internal knowledge limits but must also simultaneously generate domain-specific logic and optimize high-level topology, leading to a severe architectural coupling that degrades overall system efficacy. To bridge this gap, we propose Unified-MAS that decouples granular node implementation from topological orchestration via offline node synthesis. Unified-MAS operates in two stages: (1) Search-Based Node Generation retrieves external open-world knowledge to synthesize specialized node blueprints, overcoming the internal knowledge limits of LLMs; and (2) Reward-Based Node Optimization utilizes a perplexity-guided reward to iteratively enhance the internal logic of bottleneck nodes. Extensive experiments across four specialized domains demonstrate that integrating Unified-MAS into four Automatic-MAS baselines yields a better performance-cost trade-off, achieving up to a 14.2% gain while significantly reducing costs. Further analysis reveals its robustness across different designer LLMs and its effectiveness on conventional tasks such as mathematical reasoning.

sections.title: 通用节点与即时生成的两难
paragraphs: 自动多智能体系统生成被视为解决复杂推理任务的一种有前景的范式，但进入知识密集型领域时，节点的专业能力成为关键问题。依赖静态通用节点库的框架，例如使用思维链节点的框架，可能缺少所需的领域专长。
另一种做法是即时生成节点，但编排器既受自身知识范围限制，又要同时生成领域逻辑和优化高层拓扑。摘要认为，这种架构耦合会降低系统整体效能。

sections.title: 离线合成专业节点，分离实现与编排
paragraphs: Unified-MAS 的核心思路是通过**离线节点合成**，将细粒度的节点实现与拓扑编排解耦。它首先采用基于搜索的节点生成，检索外部开放世界知识，合成专业化的节点蓝图，以突破大语言模型内部知识的限制。
随后，基于奖励的节点优化利用困惑度引导的奖励，迭代改进瓶颈节点的内部逻辑。摘要将这两个环节作为方法的两个阶段，但没有给出奖励的具体计算方式或节点蓝图的详细形式。

papers.title: Unified Context Evolution for LLM Agents
papers.abstract: LLM-based agents can solve multi-step interactive tasks by combining reasoning with environment feedback, yet each episode starts from the same fixed context and any useful strategy discovered along the way is lost once the task ends. Existing approaches either limit learning to the current task or pool all experience into a single untyped store, without distinguishing knowledge types, tracking quality through use, or balancing what the library still lacks. We introduce Unified Context Evolution (UCE), a gradient-free framework that externalizes agent experience into an evolving library of typed Evolvable Context Units (ECUs). UCE decomposes experience into four complementary types (Memory, Strategy, Workflow, and Skill), each generated from trajectories under type-specific conditions, retrieved at decision time, scored through repeated usage outcomes, and pruned when no longer valuable. A scheduling module allocates each cycle’s generation budget toward the types where the library is weakest. Across two interactive benchmarks, UCE raises ALFWorld success from 75.4% to 96.3% and WebShop task score from 45.1% to 61.3%, and remains effective across alternative actor reasoning backbones without model retraining.

paragraphs: 基于大语言模型的智能体可以结合推理与环境反馈，解决多步交互任务。但摘要指出，每次任务开始时使用的是相同的固定上下文，过程中发现的有用策略也会随任务结束而流失。
已有方法要么将学习限制在当前任务，要么把经验汇集到不区分类型的单一存储中。后者难以区分知识类别、依据使用情况跟踪质量，也没有兼顾知识库仍然缺少哪些内容。

papers.title: TRUST-SQL: Tool-Integrated Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning for Text-to-SQL over Unknown Schemas
papers.abstract: Text-to-SQL parsing has achieved remarkable progress under the Full Schema Assumption, where the complete database structure is pre-loaded into the model’s context. Yet this assumption overlooks a more fundamental capability question of whether an LLM agent can resolve a query without explicit access to the underlying tables and relations. Moreover, full-schema injection may exceed the effective context window, introduce irrelevant metadata into the reasoning process, and become less reliable as databases evolve. We therefore study the Unknown Schema setting, in which an agent must actively explore the database and commit to only the relevant subset of metadata. To address this, we propose TRUST-SQL (Truthful Reasoning with Unknown Schema via Tools). We formulate the task as a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process in which our autonomous agent follows a structured four-phase protocol to ground reasoning in verified metadata. This protocol provides a structural boundary for our novel Phase-Aware GRPO strategy, which applies token-level masked advantages to isolate exploration rewards from execution outcomes and resolve credit assignment, yielding a 9.9% relative improvement over standard GRPO. Extensive experiments across five benchmarks demonstrate that TRUST-SQL is effective at multiple scales (4B/ 8B/14B). Despite operating entirely without pre-loaded metadata, our agent matches or surpasses prior baselines on most benchmarks that rely on schema prefilling.

papers.title_zh: TRUST-SQL：面向未知数据库模式的工具集成多轮强化学习

article.lead: 当数据库结构没有预先提供给模型，大语言模型智能体还能把自然语言问题转化为 SQL 查询吗？TRUST-SQL 围绕这一问题，将数据库探索与强化学习结合，为理解未知结构下的 Text-to-SQL 提供了一个切入点。

sections.title: 从完整结构预载到未知结构探索
paragraphs: Text-to-SQL 的许多进展建立在“完整结构假设”上：模型的上下文中预先装入完整数据库结构。但这并不能直接回答，智能体在不了解底层表及其关系时，能否自行解决查询问题。
摘要指出，注入完整结构可能超出有效上下文窗口，也可能让无关元数据干扰推理；随着数据库演变，这种方式的可靠性还可能下降。未知结构设定因此要求智能体主动探索数据库，只选取相关的元数据子集。

sections.title: 用分阶段探索连接可信元数据与训练
paragraphs: TRUST-SQL 将任务建模为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程，让自主智能体遵循结构化的四阶段协议，以经过验证的元数据作为推理依据。摘要没有展开各阶段的具体操作。
这一协议也为 Phase-Aware GRPO 提供结构边界。该策略使用词元级掩码优势，将探索奖励与执行结果区分开来，以解决奖励归因问题。

sections.title: 无预载元数据下的基准表现
paragraphs: 摘要报告，Phase-Aware GRPO 相较标准 GRPO 获得了 9.9% 的相对提升。该结果对应摘要所述比较，不宜据此推断所有任务或配置都有相同增幅。
作者还报告了跨五个基准的实验，称 TRUST-SQL 在 4B/8B/14B 多种模型规模下有效。尽管没有预先加载元数据，智能体在多数基准上的表现仍达到或超过依赖结构预填充的既有基线。

sections.title: 摘要尚未展开的比较与验证范围
paragraphs: 仅凭摘要，无法判断各基准的样本规模、具体评价指标和数据构成，也无法核对各模型规模及各基准上的逐项结果。
摘要没有列出完整的基线名单、比较配置或四阶段协议细节，因此目前难以判断提升来自哪些具体环节，也无法确定结论在不同数据库演变条件下的验证范围。这些是摘要未报告的信息，并不意味着论文没有开展相关分析。

sections.title: 阅读启发：关注探索与结果如何归因
paragraphs: 对关注大语言模型智能体的读者，一个值得继续追问的问题是：面对未知数据库结构，智能体如何确认所选元数据足以支撑查询？阅读论文时可进一步关注四阶段协议及其元数据验证方式。
另一个阅读重点是探索奖励与执行结果的区分：可结合文中具体比较，理解词元级掩码优势如何应用，以及报告的相对提升是在什么评价条件下得到的。
